state.project: Miu World: a 3D voxel learn-while-playing online game for all ages; 12 maps, each core 800x800 blocks with several named zones, plus generated land around. Owner's north star: lively, never boring. Co-op (party of 2-4 with team boss, shared HP) is being built now.
facts: Each map has exactly one friendly boss fight today (12 total), as a quest in the map's last chapter: 7 skill questions, each right answer takes 80 of 500 HP, losing costs nothing, full reward every replay.
The minimap and full map mark only the current quest target, storytellers (NPC stories) and minigame givers; a boss is not marked unless its quest is the current one.
The owner asks: should bosses show on the minimap, and is one boss per map too few for the map's size?

boss_on_map.instructions: Should bosses be marked on the minimap and the full map?

criteria.always_marked: Yes: every boss always has its own friendly icon on the minimap and full map, with a tap-to-walk-there like quests.
criteria.only_when_current: Only when the boss quest is the current quest.

boss_count.instructions: How many boss fights per map?

criteria.map_boss_plus_zone_guardians: One big map boss plus 3-4 smaller zone guardians per map (one in each main zone), each with its own character, skills of that zone's lessons, shorter fights (4-5 questions), and the big boss also playable as a co-op team boss.
criteria.map_boss_plus_daily: Keep one boss per map but add a daily rotating guardian somewhere on the map.
